chars.SAAD: SAAD: a young Moroccan man of 25 wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.KHADIJA: KHADIJA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a long burgundy coat over a cream sweater, a beige headscarf and black boots.
chars.MAMA: MAMA: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a green floral house djellaba and a white headscarf.
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a teenage girl wearing a pink tracksuit with a white stripe and a ponytail scarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside the front door of a Moroccan family apartment in Casablanca. MAMA firmly holds KHADIJA's hand and pulls her back from the open door, insisting she stays; KHADIJA looks shocked and hesitant; SAAD stands behind them frozen with wide eyes. Tense, surprising moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the hallway, MAMA points up the staircase toward SAAD's bedroom while looking at KHADIJA; SAAD rubs the back of his neck, embarrassed; KHADIJA covers her mouth, surprised.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A cosy Moroccan salon with long sedari couches and a low table with mint tea and cake. MAMA and SISTER laugh and tease SAAD, who hides his face in his hands; KHADIJA sits smiling shyly.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The same Moroccan salon suddenly almost dark, only blue moonlight from the window. SAAD and KHADIJA stand close in the darkness, both looking around surprised.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a dim hallway lit by a phone flashlight, SAAD holds KHADIJA's hand and guides her carefully back toward the salon; she follows him, nervous.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SAAD hurries quickly up a Moroccan tiled staircase at night toward the upper floor of the apartment, looking back over his shoulder, nervous.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a bedroom with a simple bed, SISTER hands KHADIJA a folded pair of striped pajamas; KHADIJA takes them, a bit embarrassed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, upstairs corridor: SAAD stands right in front of a half-open bedroom door with warm light spilling out, his hand reaching toward the handle, looking hesitant and nervous. Suspenseful.
